targets.function_of_the_whole_entry: S1 region attaches the virion to the cell membrane by interacting with host ACE2, initiating the infection (PubMed:15897467, PubMed:19901337, PubMed:29142129). Binding to the receptor probably induces conformational changes in the S glycoprotein unmasking the fusion peptide and activating membranes fusion. S2 region belongs to the class I viral fusion protein. Under the current model, the protein has at least 3 conformational states: pre-fusion native state, pre-hairpin intermediate state, and post-fusion hairpin state. During viral and target cell membrane fusion, the coiled coil regions (heptad repeats) regions assume a trimer-of-hairpins structure, positioning the fusion peptide in close proximity to the C-terminal region of the ectodomain. The formation of this structure appears to drive apposition and subsequent fusion of viral and target cell membranes

targets.function: The papain-like proteinase 1 (PLP1) and papain-like proteinase 2 (PLP2) are responsible for the cleavages located at the N-terminus of the replicase polyprotein. Contains an ADP-ribose hydrolase activity that binds ADP-ribose and catalyzes the removal of mono-ADP-ribose (de-MARylation), usually bound to a glutamate or aspartate (By similarity). ADP-ribose hydrolase activity allows the virus to interfere with the host immune defenses involving poly-ADP-ribose polymerases (PARPs) (Probable). In addition, PLP2 possesses a deubiquitinating/deISGylating activity and processes both 'Lys-48'- and 'Lys-63'-linked polyubiquitin chains from cellular substrates (PubMed:20181693). PLP2 also antagonizes innate immune induction of type I interferon by blocking the nuclear translocation of host IRF-3 (PubMed:20181693)

targets.function: RNA-directed RNA polymerase that catalyzes the transcription of viral genomic and subgenomic RNAs. Acts in complex with nsp7 and nsp8 to transcribe both the minus and positive strands of genomic RNA. The kinase-like NiRAN domain of NSP12 attaches one or more nucleotides to the amino terminus of NSP9, forming a covalent RNA-protein intermediate that serves as transcription/replication primer. Subgenomic RNAs (sgRNAs) are formed by discontinuous transcription: The polymerase has the ability to pause at transcription-regulating sequences (TRS) and jump to the leader TRS, resulting in a major deletion. This creates a series of subgenomic RNAs that are replicated, transcribed and translated. In addition, Nsp12 is a subunit of the viral RNA capping enzyme that catalyzes the RNA guanylyltransferase reaction for genomic and sub-genomic RNAs. Subsequently, the NiRAN domain transfers RNA to GDP, and forms the core cap structure GpppA-RNA

sites.caveat: An area measured on a prediction is comparable with another prediction and not with a deposition; on the one chain carrying both, the prediction read several times larger. The residue positions transfer far better than the area does.

numbering.residues_in_the_chain: 1-based within the mature chain. This is the numbering to type into a structure viewer.
numbering.residues_in_the_reading_frame: 1-based along one open reading frame of this genome. Meaningless without `reading_frame`, which is on the target this site belongs to.
numbering.residues_nt: genome coordinate of each residue's codon, 1-based inclusive, low coordinate first on either strand. Absent where the reading frame was not confirmed.

sites.what_it_is: residues a curator marked on the nearest relative as an active site, a binding site or a cleavage site, carried into this genome's numbering through the alignment
sites.caveat: A marked residue is an annotation transferred from a relative and was not measured on this pathogen. A cleavage site is where this protein is cut, which is not the same as somewhere to bind it.

numbering.residues_in_the_chain: 1-based within the mature chain. This is the numbering to type into a structure viewer.
numbering.residues_in_the_reading_frame: 1-based along one open reading frame of this genome. Meaningless without `reading_frame`, which is on the target this site belongs to.
numbering.residues_nt: genome coordinate of each residue's codon, 1-based inclusive, low coordinate first on either strand. Absent where the reading frame was not confirmed.

limitations: No row here is a measurement on the pathogen. Function, families, partners and marked residues are curated annotation on the nearest reviewed relative, transferred across a species gap. A deposited area is measured on a relative's domain; a predicted area is measured on coordinates a model emitted.

An area measured on predicted coordinates is comparable with another prediction and not with a deposition. On the one chain carrying both, the prediction read several times larger. Residue positions transfer far better than areas do.

A nucleotide range appears only where the reading frame was settled. `nt_confirmed_at` says how. Most chains are their reading frame's whole translation, were never cut out of a polyprotein and cross no species gap, so their coordinate is exact by construction. A chain that was cut out of one is placed by alignment and its frame is confirmed by reading the residues back against the relative; there `nt_confirmed_at` names which end of the span that covered, because a chain spanning a ribosomal frameshift can be exact at one end and short at the other.

`residues_in_the_chain` is 1-based within the mature chain and is the numbering for a structure viewer. `residues_in_the_reading_frame` is 1-based along one reading frame of this genome and is meaningless without the frame in the same row.
A cleavage site is where this protein is cut. It is a marked residue and it is not somewhere to bind.

The ranking is the pipeline's five stated weights. Fitting those weights against the proteins approved antivirals already act on does not improve them, which is recorded in runs/rubric_fit.json; the ranking is carried by the terms rather than their weighting.

`already_drugged` marks a target an approved or late-stage antiviral acts on, which is the label set this pipeline is scored against. It is not a claim that the target is easy, and an unmarked target is not a claim that it is novel.
